content.introduction: The sources indicate that several companies have announced their earnings dates for the third quarter of 2026. Ultra Clean Holdings, Inc. will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on October 27, 2026, and Comstock Resources, Inc. plans to release its third quarter 2026 results on November 4, 2026. Additionally, Le groupe SWI reported strong results for the first half of 2026, and Dar Global announced a 66% growth in its revenue for the first half of 2026. No specific earnings breaking news or press releases are available for today, October 6, 2026.
